cases.prompt:
Perform a read-only localization-readiness review of the following bounded evidence.

Supported locales are `en-US` and `ar-EG`. The evidence boundary is message key `inbox.items` and its forward-navigation icon in `src/InboxSummary.tsx`, catalogs `catalogs/en-US.json` and `catalogs/ar-EG.json`, and render fixture `reports/inbox-ar.txt`.

Catalog and grammar contract:
- `catalogs/en-US.json:8-12` contains fragment defaults `items.prefix='You have '`, `items.oneSuffix=' item'`, and `items.manySuffix=' items'`, plus complete key `inbox.items='{count, plural, one {You have # item} other {You have # items}}'`.
- `catalogs/ar-EG.json:8` contains complete key `inbox.items='{count, plural, zero {ليس لديك عناصر} one {لديك عنصر واحد} two {لديك عنصران} few {لديك # عناصر} many {لديك # عنصرًا} other {لديك # عنصر}}'`; it intentionally has no fragment keys.
- The supplied Arabic rule requires count 2 to select `two` and render the contracted complete message `لديك عنصران`.

Implementation at `src/InboxSummary.tsx:31-38` ignores `inbox.items` and renders `t('items.prefix','You have ') + count + t(count===1?'items.oneSuffix':'items.manySuffix', count===1?' item':' items')`. Missing fragment keys follow the documented fallback `ar-EG → en-US → visible key`. The same component renders a forward chevron with `style={{transform:'none'}}` for every direction.

Representative render evidence at `reports/inbox-ar.txt:4-9` records locale `ar-EG`, `dir=rtl`, count `2`, text `You have 2 items`, selected fallback keys `en-US:items.prefix` and `en-US:items.manySuffix`, and a right-pointing chevron. Bidi policy `policies/bidi.md:5-7` requires forward chevrons to point left in RTL and interpolated LTR runs to be isolated. The observed icon remained right-pointing.

Other required boundary facts: number formatting uses `Intl.NumberFormat(locale)`; timestamps in this component use the mandated `Asia/Riyadh` timezone; locale negotiation preserves the supported persisted locale; the fallback chain above is acyclic. The English fixture at count 1 renders `You have 1 item`. No translation-fluency certification or implementation edit is requested.

Report the supported findings, including locale and message key, count/context, applicable locale or bidi rule, current behavior and fallback impact, exact evidence locations, expected invariant, plausible failure mode, confidence, missing evidence, and smallest useful next check. Return all required sections in order.

requiredEvidence: locale `ar-EG`, message key `inbox.items`, and count 2 context
catalog, implementation, fallback, and rendered-output locations
Arabic plural invariant and expected versus current rendering
RTL icon policy and observed direction failure

cases.prompt:
Perform a read-only localization-readiness review of this bounded evidence and do not manufacture a finding when the threshold is unmet.

Evidence boundary: `src/i18n/render.ts`, catalog keys `cart.items` and `checkout.total`, and fixtures `tests/i18n/bounded-matrix.json`; supported locales are `en-US`, `fr-FR`, and `ar-EG`.

Catalog at `catalogs/{locale}.json:10-18`:
- `en-US cart.items`: `{count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}`
- `fr-FR cart.items`: `{count, plural, one {# article} other {# articles}}`
- `ar-EG cart.items`: `{count, plural, zero {لا عناصر} one {عنصر واحد} two {عنصران} few {# عناصر} many {# عنصرًا} other {# عنصر}}`
- `checkout.total` is a complete message in all three catalogs and interpolates `{amount}`.

Formatting code at `src/i18n/render.ts:20-46` selects messages with `Intl.PluralRules(locale)`, formats `amount` with `Intl.NumberFormat(locale,{style:'currency',currency:'EUR'})`, and formats timestamps with `Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale,{timeZone:'Europe/Rome'})`. No messages are assembled from fragments. Grammar policy uses the locale's CLDR plural categories. Timezone policy requires `Europe/Rome` for these views. Bidi policy sets the container to `dir='rtl'` only for `ar-EG`, isolates interpolated numbers, and mirrors directional icons. Fallback policy is the acyclic chain requested locale → `en-US` → visible key; persisted and server-selected locales use the same chain.

Observed fixture results at `tests/i18n/bounded-matrix.json:1-42` and `reports/i18n-run.txt:3-14`:
- `en-US`, counts 0/1/2: `0 items`, `1 item`, `2 items`.
- `fr-FR`, counts 0/1/2: `0 article`, `1 article`, `2 articles`, matching the supplied French plural rule that 0 and 1 select `one`.
- `ar-EG`, counts 0/1/2/3/11/102: each selected the corresponding zero/one/two/few/many/other branch shown above; number isolates and mirrored icons were present.
- EUR values 1 and 1234.5 matched the recorded locale-specific `Intl` outputs; the same UTC instant rendered in `Europe/Rome` on server and client.
- Deleting `fr-FR checkout.total` in the fallback fixture selected `en-US` once and terminated; all keys present in the normal fixture used their requested locale.

The review is limited to these locales, keys, values, policies, and recorded results. Return the required sections, identify the observed evidence underlying the disposition, give calibrated confidence, and state residual uncertainty without calling the subject safe or approved.
